source.source_attribution: BCE per-butterfly foodplants are derived from Clarke (2024), Ecology and Evolution DOI 10.1002/ece3.10834, filtered to evidence ranks 1-3. This is a secondary derivative, not original independent observations.

species_selection: ALL 92 exact Latin butterfly binomials in both the frozen 239-species chocho sample and BCE's 501-species website; no butterfly selected by host outcomes.
site_drift_control: Require exactly 92 matched species, else report taxonomy drift and stop.
plant_name_rule: Exact genus plus simple species epithet; exclude genus-only, subspecies, hybrids and ambiguous names. Zero species-level BCE host lists are NOT negative biological evidence.
outputs: Per butterfly exact BCE host names, exact fixed HOSTS host names, and lexical overlap
Pooled BCE-only and HOSTS-only exact names, number of valid species pages and reasons for missingness
BCE taxonomy and species page SHA256, URL, parsed table row counts
stops: Exact spelling differences require later synonym and WCVP reconciliation before biological missing-edge claims
European sample must never be extrapolated to all 239 butterflies
No colonization, demography, fitness or new global resource geography claim
Compiled source references can overlap between BCE and HOSTS
Do not select species or plant subsets after examining the output
If over one quarter of BCE species pages fail, stop the crosswalk
